title: hive-route bindings, format 1: long-running agents whose model comes from their harness's config (OpenClaw), and what the router decides for each (ROUTING.md §9.3)

config.description: The OpenClaw config file the patch is for (a key of the output's patches).

facts.description: As in a request (request-v1.schema.json), without kind.

author.description: For a review binding: the author's family and tier (RT4).

fallback_floor.description: The lowest tier fallbacks may come from (default: the binding's own tier). An always-on agent may prefer a weaker answer to none.

route.description: Fixed mode: the route (default: the table's fixed route for the kind).

fallbacks.description: Fixed mode: the fallback routes, in order.

sessions.description: The agent's OpenClaw session databases (globs), for drift checks.
